policy_summary: Bind NPC quest-entry triggers to linked decoded textblock stage scripts.
Evaluate every clause condition before mutation.
Execute the first matching clause in decoded source-line order.
Fail closed for unsupported opcodes or unresolved references.
Rollback local character quest state, inventory, currency, experience, and flags when execution fails.
Expose world-affecting operations as host intents unless the host has a verified immediate handler.

document.rule: Evaluate every condition on a source line before executing any state-changing, presentation, or branch operation from that line.
document.condition_order: source sequence among conditions with short-circuit on first failure
document.execution_order: source sequence among non-condition operations after successful preflight
reason: Four source lines encode prerequisites after item, message, or reward operations.
Literal token-by-token execution could consume or grant state before a later prerequisite fails.
Atomic preflight preserves every directive and prevents partial quest-state corruption.
document.fallback: Abort the entire clause without mutation when a condition, reference, or target cannot be evaluated.
document.save_world_state_impact: Prevents partial inventory, ability, experience, alignment, summon, teleport, and quest-flag mutations.
tests: All 182 quest-stage scripts compile into source-line clauses.
All 490 clauses preserve non-condition source order.
Every source-line condition appears in preflight, including four late-position condition clauses.

runtime_behavior.addexp: Add the decoded signed amount to character experience.
runtime_behavior.addevil: Move alignment toward evil by subtracting the decoded amount.
runtime_behavior.message: Emit a canonical message reference without mutating quest state.
runtime_behavior.text: Return the canonical target textblock as the next dialogue branch.

evidence: MMExplorer operation names and numeric arguments are syntactically decoded with zero unknown opcodes.
All four operations have deterministic local representations and require no room/NPC/world-object lookup.
Source-order clause execution and rollback semantics were established in Updates 0200-0202.
assumptions: addevil uses the repository alignment convention where lower values are more evil.
text selects the decoded target textblock and does not itself execute that target recursively.
message resolves through the native message catalog at presentation time.
document.fallback: Fail the entire atomic clause and roll back local state when arguments are missing or a later external handler fails.
tests: 43 addexp, 3 addevil, 130 message, and 389 text operations are recognized.
Experience and alignment roll back when a later operation fails.
Message and text emit canonical IDs without hidden mutation.

rules: Group stage scripts only when quest, NPC, and root textblock relationships all match.
Evaluate linked scripts in ascending decoded stage order.
Within each script execute only the first atomic clause whose complete prerequisite set passes.
A missing or ambiguous trigger/script relationship fails safely without character or world mutation.
Preserve canonical script, quest, NPC, and textblock identifiers in runtime and Librarium records.
provenance: Data/Classic/scripts.json relationships generated from MMExplorer textblocks
Data/Classic/triggers.json canonical projection generated in pass 0206
assumptions: Decoded stage_index represents dialogue-stage evaluation order.
NPC interaction is the entry event for records grouped under that NPC relationship.
document.fallback: No dialogue clause is selected and no state changes are committed.
document.save_or_world_state_impact: No mutation occurs until an atomic quest clause passes and all required handlers are ready.

runtime_behavior.execution_readiness_preflight: Every executable operation must have a deterministic local implementation or a registered runtime handler before the clause mutates state.
runtime_behavior.rollback: If a runtime handler fails, all locally represented quest state is restored to its pre-clause snapshot.
runtime_behavior.external_side_effect_contract: Registered external handlers must be transactional or idempotent because external systems cannot be automatically rolled back by the local executor.

document.fallback: Fail the clause without mutation when any executable operation lacks a handler.
document.save_world_state_impact: Prevents partially applied inventory, ability, quest-state, teleport, summon, experience, alignment, presentation, or branch effects.

document.scope: MMExplorer quest textblock runtime clause execution
rules: Preflight every condition before any state mutation.
Execute effects, messages, and branches in original non-condition source order.
Unsupported or unresolved operations fail closed and produce no mutation.
External effects such as teleport, summon, cast, experience, alignment, messages, and branches require explicit runtime handlers.
assumptions: Each source line is an independent candidate clause until native DLL evidence proves continuation semantics.
First passing source-line clause is selected.
document.fallback: Abort before mutation when a condition or executable operation cannot be handled safely.
document.save_world_state_impact: Prevents partial inventory, quest flag, reward, teleport, summon, and message side effects.
tests: Blocked Dao Lord clause does not consume its item or advance its ability flag.
Passing Dao Lord clause executes item removal, ability transition, and branch in source order.
Every compiled operation reference resolves to the original decoded operation.

rules.threshold_interpretation: cumulative upper bounds in ascending numeric-selection order
rules.selection: first threshold greater than or equal to roll
rules.multiple_random_directives: independent rolls executed in parent source order
rules.atomicity: selected child clause and parent clause are one transaction
rules.fallback: fail closed when table missing, malformed, or incomplete

assumptions: Numeric selection values are cumulative percentage thresholds, supported by Textblock(rndm) ownership and complete 100 coverage.
document.save_world_state_impact: May grant or consume quest items; requires transactional commit.

document.summary: Decoded cast, summon, teleport, and remoteaction operations emit typed deferred world intents. The Host must validate and atomically commit the complete clause result with local quest-state changes.

random.reason: selection probability and continuation semantics are not decoded

assumptions: Decoded numeric identifiers are the intended native targets.
Emitting an intent is not equivalent to applying the native world mutation.
The Host commits all intents and local quest-state changes atomically or commits none.
document.fallback: Reject the clause without mutation when the Host cannot validate every emitted world intent.
document.save_world_state_impact: Cast, summon, teleport, and remote actions may change character or world state only after Host atomic commit.
